work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission of five repeated harness arms from a same-model local coding benchmark. Each of Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi and Hermes is run five times against a fresh copy of one fixed cross-module bug task. W1 uses objective pytest fix pass rate over five runs as the primary factual outcome and preserves per-run token totals plus source token/call summaries as separate telemetry.

source_known_dimensions: same published DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 build identity: 0xSero/deepseek-v4-flash-0731-spark EXL3 3.0 bpw
same single DGX Spark model server with 384000 context and MAX_NUM_SEQS=1
same common metering proxy and upstream model alias rewrite
thinking=false forced by the proxy for every lane
same fixed hermes-agent@3a8d95a93bdc task plus committed test patch
fresh workdir from an immutable tarball each run
same two objective pytest files used to determine pass/fail
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact historical package/source revisions for Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Pi and Hermes
exact served weight-file hash beyond the published model build identity
Codex uses Responses API translation while other lanes use their native compatible API paths
harness-native prompts, context management, tool loops and retry behavior differ by design
Hermes runs natively on the Spark whereas Codex/OpenCode/OpenClaw/Pi run through the common runner-container path
original per-request meter JSONL logs and full agent trajectories are not committed; the committed generator contains the 25 re-derived per-run rows

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admitted from a committed 25-row per-run table re-derived by the publisher from meter logs, plus public task/proxy/runner/test implementation; original local meter logs remain explicitly unavailable

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The repository publishes a rigorous 200-task same-model protocol with hidden graders, repeated trials and statistical analysis, but its out/ result directory is gitignored, repository releases are empty, and W1 located no committed real result table distinct from the illustrative README example.
The repository publishes a 153-task multi-harness benchmark/runtime and matched-model design, but W1 located no immutable committed executed leaderboard/result artifact at the pinned revision.
The tool preserves local Codex/Claude run evidence and supports repeated trials, but W1 located no committed real cross-harness result surface in the pinned repository.

The Git repository publishes reproducible same-model profiles and local run manifests, while leaderboard results are published through a separate web/backend path. W1 did not locate an immutable result snapshot in the pinned Git repository suitable for append-only admission.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: source headline that reliability rather than cost is the real differentiator
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 preserves pass rates and token/call/wall-time telemetry separately. It does not form a composite or promote the publisher's evaluative interpretation.
